        "contents": "enable_signup = true\n# Allow/disallow anonymous sign-ins to your project.\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false\n# Allow/disallow testing manual linking of accounts\nenable_manual_linking = false\n# Passwords shorter than this value will be rejected as weak.         "contents": "skip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/rules/nextjs-development.mdc",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 179

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 256
          }

        "contents": "### ORM Best Practices\n\n- Use type-safe ORMs (Drizzle, Prisma, etc.)\n- Define schemas with proper relationships and constraints\n- Infer types from schema definitions\n- Write repository-style helpers to isolate queries\n- Implement proper migrations\n\n### Data Access Patterns\n\n- Keep database queries in dedicated modules\n- Avoid N+1 queries; use joins and CTEs\n- Implement pagination for list endpoints\n- Use select projections to limit payload size\n\n## Authentication &amp; Authorization\n\n- Implement server-side auth checks\n- Never trust client-side auth flags\n- Use middleware for route protection\n- Store user data securely with proper encryption\n\n## Testing Strategy\n\n### Unit Testing (Vitest)\n\n- **Never mock internal code** - only mock external dependencies\n- Use MSW for API mocking when needed\n- Test utilities, repositories, and business logic\n- Mock external services (APIs, databases, file systems)\n\n### Component Testing (React Testing Library)\n\n- Test interactive components with proper accessibility\n- Ensure loading and error states are covered\n- Test user interactions and state changes\n- Use data-testid sparingly; <tool-use data-tool-type="unknown" data-tool-name="mcp-supabase-user-supabase-apply_migration">
<details>
<summary>Tool use: **mcp-supabase-user-supabase-apply_migration**</summary>


Parameters:

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "apply_migration",
      "parameters": "{\"name\":\"create_profiles_and_teams_tables\",\"query\":\"-- Enable MODDATETIME extension for automatic updated_at timestamps\\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS moddatetime;\\n\\n-- Role enum for profiles\\nCREATE TYPE public.profile_role AS ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- Teams table\\nCREATE TABLE public.teams (\\n  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text NOT NULL,\\n  picture text,\\n  color text,\\n  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,\\n  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL\\n);\\n\\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\\nCREATE TABLE public.profiles (\\n  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text NOT NULL,\\n  picture text,  -- defaults to Google profile picture on link\\n  user_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,  -- linked after OTP verification\\n  work_email text UNIQUE NOT NULL,\\n  role public.profile_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',\\n  team_id uuid REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\\n  removed_access_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,\\n  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,\\n  CONSTRAINT valid_czu_domain CHECK (\\n    work_email LIKE '%@studenti.czu.cz' OR work_email LIKE '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\n-- Indexes for common queries\\nCREATE INDEX profiles_user_id_idx ON public.profiles(user_id);\\nCREATE INDEX profiles_work_email_idx ON public.profiles(work_email);\\nCREATE INDEX profiles_team_id_idx ON public.profiles(team_id);\\n\\n-- Enable automatic updated_at timestamps\\nCREATE TRIGGER handle_updated_at_teams\\n  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.teams\\n  FOR EACH ROW\\n  EXECUTE FUNCTION moddatetime(updated_at);\\n\\nCREATE TRIGGER handle_updated_at_profiles\\n  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles\\n  FOR EACH ROW\\n  EXECUTE FUNCTION moddatetime(updated_at);\\n\\n-- RLS Policies\\nALTER TABLE public.teams ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\\nALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\\n\\n-- Teams: All authenticated users can read teams\\nCREATE POLICY \\\"Teams are viewable by authenticated users\\\"\\n  ON public.teams\\n  FOR SELECT\\n  TO authenticated\\n  USING (true);\\n\\n-- Profiles: Users can read their own profile\\nCREATE POLICY \\\"Users can view own profile\\\"\\n  ON public.profiles\\n  FOR SELECT\\n  TO authenticated\\n  USING (auth.uid() = user_id);\\n\\n-- Profiles: Users can update their own profile (except role and removed_access)\\nCREATE POLICY \\\"Users can update own profile\\\"\\n  ON public.profiles\\n  FOR UPDATE\\n  TO authenticated\\n  USING (auth.uid() = user_id)\\n  WITH CHECK (\\n    auth.uid() = user_id AND\\n    -- Prevent users from modifying role or removed_access\\n    (OLD.role = NEW.role OR OLD.role IS NULL) AND\\n    (OLD.removed_access = NEW.removed_access)\\n  );\\n\\n-- Profiles: Service role can insert/update/delete (for admin operations)\\n-- Note: Admin operations will be handled via service role in server actions\\n-- This policy allows service role to manage profiles\\nCREATE POLICY \\\"Service role can manage profiles\\\"\\n  ON public.profiles\\n  FOR ALL\\n  TO service_role\\n  USING (true)\\n  WITH CHECK (true);\\n\\n-- Teams: Service role can manage teams\\nCREATE POLICY \\\"Service role can manage teams\\\"\\n  ON public.teams\\n  FOR ALL\\n  TO service_role\\n  USING (true)\\n  WITH CHECK (true);\\n\"}",
      "serverName": "supabase"
    }
  ]
}
```
